notes: Each eval runs against a throwaway git repo built by fixtures/setup_fixture.sh <scenario> <dest>. The repo is checked out on branch 'feature' with origin/develop holding conflicting work. The subagent is told to merge develop and resolve conflicts inside that repo. Grading is programmatic via grade.js <scenario> <repoPath>.

evals.prompt: Merge the latest remote develop branch into my current branch and resolve any merge conflicts.
evals.expected_output: develop merged into feature; src/settings.ts keeps BOTH timeout (from develop) and retries (from feature); no conflict markers; merge committed; report explains the resolution. Taking either side wholesale is wrong.
assertions: Merge completed, no merge in progress
No unmerged paths / no conflict markers
Both timeout and retries preserved in settings.ts

evals.prompt: Merge origin/develop into this branch and fix the conflicts so everything still builds.
evals.expected_output: data/chains.json merged to include all three chains; data/chains.generated.json is REGENERATED via the generator (npm run generate / scripts/generate.js), not hand-merged; no markers; merge committed; report notes the regenerate.
assertions: Merge completed, no merge in progress
generated file matches a fresh regenerate (count=3)

evals.prompt: Can you merge the latest develop into my branch and sort out the conflicts? I've got some unfinished edits in my working tree too.
evals.expected_output: Working tree auto-stashed (modified notes.txt + untracked scratch.txt), develop merged, routes.ts conflict resolved keeping all three routes, stash reapplied so notes.txt='v2 WIP' and scratch.txt survive; merge committed; report mentions the stash.
assertions: Merge completed, develop merged into HEAD
